seed_policy: arm9 unconditional B/BL branch targets plus push{...,lr} prologues
finding: Every exact match was a branch-target fragment, not a function entry (not a BL target and not a prologue). These extents begin inside a larger routine: live-in callee-saved registers, backward branches to before the extent, or bare add-sp/pop epilogues. A standalone C function cannot own those bytes.
action: No fragment was integrated, banked as a candidate, or credited. functions-v5.json was restored to its prior reviewed 660 entries.
conclusion: The bounded ARM9 leaf pool is effectively exhausted. Further verified gains need overlay/Thumb support or call-aware (non-leaf) reconstruction, not more leaf sweeps.
